provenance: Synthetic, single-author challenge items authored before V10 implementation and frozen for this cycle. No independent reviewers or real-world sampling.
annotationAudit: None yet. Any post-scoring label correction will be disclosed here without changing texts or split membership.

items.text: You've won a reward! DM me in private to claim it.
items.targetingEvidence: Full triad with a contracted winner opener.
items.rationale: Same high-confidence scam family as development with different wording.

items.text: مبروك كسبت الجائزة، بعتلي على الخاص عشان تستلمها.
items.targetingEvidence: Winner opener, alternate private-contact verb, and collection.
items.rationale: Arabic private-contact variant of the triad.

items.text: You won a gift card, message me privately to collect.
items.targetingEvidence: Reward opener, private contact, and collection co-occur.
items.rationale: Different reward noun with the same scam structure.

items.text: Congrats! You won a prize. DM me in private to claim.
items.rationale: Multi-sentence opener still exhibits all three co-occurrence signals.

items.text: I won a prize in the school raffle, collect it from the office tomorrow.
items.targetingEvidence: Reward and collection without private contact.
items.rationale: Legitimate public prize logistics stay visible.

items.text: DM me the venue address after the event.
items.rationale: A private request alone is not spam.

items.text: مبروك كسبت الجائزة، كلمني على الخاص عشان نهنئك.
items.targetingEvidence: Winner opener and private contact without collection; prize wording is a contextual signal only.
items.rationale: Contextual review is correct; auto-hiding would require a collection action.

items.text: You won the debate, message me privately for feedback.
items.targetingEvidence: Private contact without claim or collection.

items.text: He shared the raffle details with me; I collected the ticket yesterday.
items.rationale: Bounded claim/collect cue avoids matching past-tense collection.

items.text: You won a raffle prize! Message me privately to claim the ticket from the organizing committee.
items.targetingEvidence: Committee attribution may make the triad legitimate.
items.rationale: Documented residual FP risk; excluded from metrics and not tuned away.
